verdicts.reason: A: '$3' sits above '2 FOR', so the offer reads backwards. The FIZZBANG logo shrinks to an unreadable pill and is jammed into a cramped bottom-left strip with a tiny CTA and tiny tagline, while a large dead area sits around the headline and the can is crowded against the right edge.
